mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) slows by more than 1 percentage point, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS YoY growth slows by > 1pp but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening economy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rising
failure_condition: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth slows by more than 2 percentage points year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth slows by > 2pp and FEDFUNDS > 4%
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth slows by > 2pp and FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising faster than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential inflationary environment that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3% and FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) growth slows by more than 5 percentage points year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5%, it signals a weakening housing market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth slows by > 5pp and UNRATE > 5%
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth slows by > 5pp and UNRATE > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
